name: Roast Butternut Squash with Fresh Mozzarella & Couscous-Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F) and place racks in the upper and center positions. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small butternut squash
3 orange bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim butternut squash ends, halve crosswise, then cut each piece in half lengthwise; scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of each squash piece with oil and season with salt and pepper; arrange pieces, cut-side down, on the baking sheets.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 25-30 minutes.
While the squash is roasting, place couscous in a large bowl.

Pour broth into a large skillet, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, pour into the bowl with the couscous, and stir (reserve skillet for later use). Tightly cover the bowl with foil and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onions crosswise; trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, thinly slice mozzarella.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the squash is done, remove from the oven and turn the pieces over, cut-side facing up. Change the oven to broil on high.
Divide mozzarella between squash pieces; working in batches, place baking sheets on the upper rack of the oven and broil until mozzarella is golden and melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add cooked veggies, basil, arugula, pine nuts, and vinegar to the bowl with the couscous. Stir to combine the couscous salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pine nuts
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide butternut squash and couscous salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
